source_text: Erica Abraham?

structure.raw_value: MeBaOp.Erica Abraham?
structure.script_literal: "MeBaOp.Erica Abraham?"

translation: Erica Abraham?

source_text: She’s willing to talk to us.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.She’s willing to talk to us.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.She’s willing to talk to us."

translation: Zgodziła się z nami porozmawiać.

source_text: Let’s get this on the record…

structure.raw_value: MeBaOp.Let’s get this on the record…
structure.script_literal: "MeBaOp.Let’s get this on the record…"

translation: Zapiszmy to w protokole…

source_text: Am I under suspicion?

structure.raw_value: ErWoOp.Am I under suspicion?
structure.script_literal: "ErWoOp.Am I under suspicion?"

translation: Jestem podejrzana?

source_text: Relax. She’s a bit of a hard ass. That’s all.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.Relax. She’s a bit of a hard ass. That’s all.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.Relax. She’s a bit of a hard ass. That’s all."

translation: Spokojnie. Po prostu jest trochę surowa.

source_text: 1Hero? Did you just walk in?

structure.raw_value: MeAnDe.1Hero? Did you just walk in?
structure.script_literal: "MeAnDe.1Hero? Did you just walk in?"

translation: 1Hero? Dopiero co wszedłeś?

source_text: Oh, uhh... I was just checking out some stuff around town before heading in.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Oh, uhh... I was just checking out some stuff around town before heading in.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Oh, uhh... I was just checking out some stuff around town before heading in."

translation: Och, yyy… Rozglądałem się po mieście, zanim tu przyszedłem.

source_text: You’re late.

structure.raw_value: MeAnDe.You’re late.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnDe.You’re late."

translation: Spóźniłeś się.

source_text: I’m going to the gymnasium. Is there something you need to tell me before you log into your computer?

structure.raw_value: MeAnEx.I’m going to the gymnasium. Is there something you need to tell me before you log into your computer?
structure.script_literal: "MeAnEx.I’m going to the gymnasium. Is there something you need to tell me before you log into your computer?"

translation: Idę na salę gimnastyczną. Jest coś, co powinieneś mi powiedzieć, zanim zalogujesz się na komputerze?

source_text: You tell me. Anything I should know?

structure.raw_value: MeAnDe.You tell me. Anything I should know?
structure.script_literal: "MeAnDe.You tell me. Anything I should know?"

translation: To ty mi powiedz. Jest coś, o czym powinienem wiedzieć?

source_text: You mean… The Guild file access? I can explain.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.You mean… The Guild file access? I can explain.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.You mean… The Guild file access? I can explain."

translation: Masz na myśli… dostęp do akt Gildii? Mogę to wyjaśnić.

source_text: That’s David’s job. Don’t make him angry.

structure.raw_value: MeAnEx.That’s David’s job. Don’t make him angry.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnEx.That’s David’s job. Don’t make him angry."

translation: To sprawa Davida. Nie denerwuj go.

source_text: Oh, yeah.

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Oh, yeah.
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.Oh, yeah."

translation: A, no tak.

source_text: I don’t know how you accessed those files, but stick to your own work and leave David alone.

structure.raw_value: MeAnEx.I don’t know how you accessed those files, but stick to your own work and leave David alone.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnEx.I don’t know how you accessed those files, but stick to your own work and leave David alone."

translation: Nie wiem, jak dostałeś się do tych akt, ale zajmij się własną pracą i zostaw Davida w spokoju.

source_text: Right, right. Sorry. It won’t happen again.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Right, right. Sorry. It won’t happen again.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Right, right. Sorry. It won’t happen again."

translation: Jasne, jasne. Przepraszam. To się nie powtórzy.

source_text: I’m watching you, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: MeAnDe.I’m watching you, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnDe.I’m watching you, 1Hero."

translation: Mam cię na oku, 1Hero.

source_text: Wait… If she checked the file access, it would be her name that comes up.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe^.Wait… If she checked the file access, it would be her name that comes up.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe^.Wait… If she checked the file access, it would be her name that comes up."

translation: Chwila… Jeśli sprawdziła dostęp do akt, w rejestrze powinno być jej nazwisko.

source_text: How did she know it was me who accessed the files?

structure.raw_value: McAnDe^.How did she know it was me who accessed the files?
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe^.How did she know it was me who accessed the files?"

translation: Skąd wiedziała, że to ja otworzyłem te akta?

source_text: Either Andrea told her, or she’s spying on my computer.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe^.Either Andrea told her, or she’s spying on my computer.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe^.Either Andrea told her, or she’s spying on my computer."

translation: Albo Andrea jej powiedziała, albo szpieguje mój komputer.

source_text: God damn it. Of course she’s spying on my computer.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe^.God damn it. Of course she’s spying on my computer.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe^.God damn it. Of course she’s spying on my computer."

translation: Cholera jasna. Oczywiście, że szpieguje mój komputer.

source_text: I should have known.

structure.raw_value: McAnOp^.I should have known.
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp^.I should have known."

translation: Mogłem się domyślić.

source_text: Up early this morning, 1Hero?

structure.raw_value: MeBaDe.Up early this morning, 1Hero?
structure.script_literal: "MeBaDe.Up early this morning, 1Hero?"

translation: Dziś wcześnie wstałeś, 1Hero?

source_text: Melissa, I need to talk to you.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Melissa, I need to talk to you.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Melissa, I need to talk to you."

translation: Melisso, muszę z tobą porozmawiać.

source_text: Walk with me, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx.Walk with me, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx.Walk with me, 1Hero."

translation: Chodź ze mną, 1Hero.

source_text: Coming back to the office this late?

structure.raw_value: DaBaDe.Coming back to the office this late?
structure.script_literal: "DaBaDe.Coming back to the office this late?"

translation: Wracasz do biura tak późno?

source_text: I’m meeting with Andrea.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.I’m meeting with Andrea.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.I’m meeting with Andrea."

translation: Spotykam się z Andreą.

source_text: What the hell did you do to Melissa? She’s been locked in her office all day.

structure.raw_value: DaAnEx.What the hell did you do to Melissa? She’s been locked in her office all day.
structure.script_literal: "DaAnEx.What the hell did you do to Melissa? She’s been locked in her office all day."

translation: Co ty, do cholery, zrobiłeś Melissie? Siedzi zamknięta w gabinecie cały dzień.

source_text: She’s mad at me. No surprise.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.She’s mad at me. No surprise.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.She’s mad at me. No surprise."

translation: Jest na mnie zła. Nic dziwnego.

source_text: She’s going to fire you one day.

structure.raw_value: DaAnEx.She’s going to fire you one day.
structure.script_literal: "DaAnEx.She’s going to fire you one day."

translation: Pewnego dnia cię zwolni.

source_text: You really want to do this?

structure.raw_value: MeBaDe.You really want to do this?
structure.script_literal: "MeBaDe.You really want to do this?"

translation: Naprawdę chcesz to zrobić?

source_text: Finally ready to become a man?

structure.raw_value: BoFlDe^.Finally ready to become a man?
structure.script_literal: "BoFlDe^.Finally ready to become a man?"

translation: W końcu jesteś gotów stać się mężczyzną?

source_text: Rinaldi! Watch your attitude.

structure.raw_value: MeAnOpNo1.Rinaldi! Watch your attitude.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnOpNo1.Rinaldi! Watch your attitude."

translation: Rinaldi! Uważaj na ton.

source_text: That’s right, 1Hero. You’re training with me.

structure.raw_value: BoFlEx^.That’s right, 1Hero. You’re training with me.
structure.script_literal: "BoFlEx^.That’s right, 1Hero. You’re training with me."

translation: Zgadza się, 1Hero. Będziesz trenować ze mną.

source_text: Have fun and good luck.

structure.raw_value: MeFlOp.Have fun and good luck.
structure.script_literal: "MeFlOp.Have fun and good luck."

translation: Baw się dobrze i powodzenia.

source_text: If you can’t hit a target, you won’t get a gun.

structure.raw_value: BoAnEx^.If you can’t hit a target, you won’t get a gun.
structure.script_literal: "BoAnEx^.If you can’t hit a target, you won’t get a gun."

translation: Jeśli nie trafisz w cel, nie dostaniesz broni.

source_text: I’ll pass your test. Don’t you worry.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.I’ll pass your test. Don’t you worry.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.I’ll pass your test. Don’t you worry."

translation: Zdam twój test. Nie martw się.

source_text: Out of my way! Someone’s trying to hack into my computer.

structure.raw_value: DaWoAgNo1.Out of my way! Someone’s trying to hack into my computer.
structure.script_literal: "DaWoAgNo1.Out of my way! Someone’s trying to hack into my computer."

translation: Z drogi! Ktoś próbuje włamać się do mojego komputera.

source_text: Sounds serious.

structure.raw_value: McFlDe.Sounds serious.
structure.script_literal: "McFlDe.Sounds serious."

translation: Brzmi poważnie.

source_text: I better hurry. I don’t know how long he plans on searching for the hacker.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp^.I better hurry. I don’t know how long he plans on searching for the hacker.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp^.I better hurry. I don’t know how long he plans on searching for the hacker."

translation: Lepiej się pospieszę. Nie wiem, jak długo zamierza szukać hakera.

source_text: I’m expecting a package. Are you the delivery man?

structure.raw_value: NPC.I’m expecting a package. Are you the delivery man?
structure.script_literal: "NPC.I’m expecting a package. Are you the delivery man?"

translation: Czekam na paczkę. To pan jest kurierem?

source_text: This doesn’t look like my box.

structure.raw_value: NPC.This doesn’t look like my box.
structure.script_literal: "NPC.This doesn’t look like my box."

translation: To nie wygląda na moją paczkę.

source_text: How annoying!

structure.raw_value: NPC.How annoying!
structure.script_literal: "NPC.How annoying!"

translation: Co za irytujące!

source_text: Whatever you say, Miss Bhatt.

structure.raw_value: DaBaDe^.Whatever you say, Miss Bhatt.
structure.script_literal: "DaBaDe^.Whatever you say, Miss Bhatt."

translation: Jak pani sobie życzy, panno Bhatt.

source_text: 1Hero, Miss Abraham will be in the interrogation room whenever you’re ready.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx.1Hero, Miss Abraham will be in the interrogation room whenever you’re ready.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx.1Hero, Miss Abraham will be in the interrogation room whenever you’re ready."

translation: 1Hero, panna Abraham będzie czekać w pokoju przesłuchań, kiedy będziesz gotów.

source_text: Seems you’ve done a good job taking my case from me.

structure.raw_value: DaBaDe.Seems you’ve done a good job taking my case from me.
structure.script_literal: "DaBaDe.Seems you’ve done a good job taking my case from me."

translation: Widzę, że dobrze ci idzie odbieranie mi sprawy.

source_text: Are you actually upset?

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.Are you actually upset?
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.Are you actually upset?"

translation: Naprawdę jesteś zła?

source_text: If you’re going to step on my toes, that means you’re doing all the paperwork too.

structure.raw_value: DaAnEx.If you’re going to step on my toes, that means you’re doing all the paperwork too.
structure.script_literal: "DaAnEx.If you’re going to step on my toes, that means you’re doing all the paperwork too."

translation: Jeśli zamierzasz wchodzić mi w drogę, to ty wypełnisz całą papierkową robotę.

source_text: I’m done.

structure.raw_value: DaAnDe.I’m done.
structure.script_literal: "DaAnDe.I’m done."

translation: Mam dość.

source_text: I’m under direct orders from Kimura. Don’t blame me.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.I’m under direct orders from Kimura. Don’t blame me.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.I’m under direct orders from Kimura. Don’t blame me."

translation: Dostałem bezpośredni rozkaz od Kimury. Nie obwiniaj mnie.

source_text: I had your energy once, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: DaAnDe.I had your energy once, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "DaAnDe.I had your energy once, 1Hero."

translation: Kiedyś i ja miałem tyle zapału co ty, 1Hero.

source_text: Don’t you think we owe it to the people to try and actually do some good here?

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.Don’t you think we owe it to the people to try and actually do some good here?
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.Don’t you think we owe it to the people to try and actually do some good here?"

translation: Nie sądzisz, że jesteśmy winni ludziom, by spróbować zrobić tu coś dobrego?

source_text: After almost four decades, I don’t get paid enough to keep caring.

structure.raw_value: DaAnOp.After almost four decades, I don’t get paid enough to keep caring.
structure.script_literal: "DaAnOp.After almost four decades, I don’t get paid enough to keep caring."

translation: Po prawie czterdziestu latach nie płacą mi wystarczająco, żebym nadal się przejmował.

source_text: She’s ready, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx.She’s ready, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx.She’s ready, 1Hero."

translation: Jest gotowa, 1Hero.

source_text: I’m putting a lot of trust in you.

structure.raw_value: MeBaDe.I’m putting a lot of trust in you.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaDe.I’m putting a lot of trust in you."

translation: Bardzo ci ufam.

source_text: If Commissioner Kimura is going to trust you, then I have no choice but to do the same.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx.If Commissioner Kimura is going to trust you, then I have no choice but to do the same.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx.If Commissioner Kimura is going to trust you, then I have no choice but to do the same."

translation: Skoro komisarz Kimura ci ufa, nie mam wyboru i też muszę ci zaufać.

source_text: If you let her down, you let me down.

structure.raw_value: MeAnDe.If you let her down, you let me down.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnDe.If you let her down, you let me down."

translation: Jeśli ją zawiedziesz, zawiedziesz też mnie.

source_text: There will be no second chances this time.

structure.raw_value: MeAnEx.There will be no second chances this time.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnEx.There will be no second chances this time."

translation: Tym razem nie będzie drugiej szansy.

source_text: If she drops you, then so will I.

structure.raw_value: MeAnOp.If she drops you, then so will I.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnOp.If she drops you, then so will I."

translation: Jeśli ona cię skreśli, ja też.

source_text: Coming in late again?

structure.raw_value: DaAnDe.Coming in late again?
structure.script_literal: "DaAnDe.Coming in late again?"

translation: Znowu się spóźniasz?

source_text: Just mind your own business, David.

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.Just mind your own business, David.
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.Just mind your own business, David."

translation: Po prostu pilnuj własnego nosa, David.

source_text: What the hell did you do to Melissa? She’s been avoiding her office all morning.

structure.raw_value: DaWoEx.What the hell did you do to Melissa? She’s been avoiding her office all morning.
structure.script_literal: "DaWoEx.What the hell did you do to Melissa? She’s been avoiding her office all morning."

translation: Co ty, do cholery, zrobiłeś Melissie? Od rana unika swojego gabinetu.

source_text: Maybe she’s meeting with Kimura in the gym…

structure.raw_value: DaBaDe.Maybe she’s meeting with Kimura in the gym…
structure.script_literal: "DaBaDe.Maybe she’s meeting with Kimura in the gym…"

translation: Może spotyka się z Kimurą na siłowni…

source_text: Seems they got it locked down.

structure.raw_value: DaBaEx.Seems they got it locked down.
structure.script_literal: "DaBaEx.Seems they got it locked down."

translation: Wygląda na to, że zamknęli ją na klucz.

source_text: 1Hero. Looking for something?

structure.raw_value: AdBaOp.1Hero. Looking for something?
structure.script_literal: "AdBaOp.1Hero. Looking for something?"

translation: 1Hero. Czegoś szukasz?

source_text: Hello, Miss Kimura. Melissa was looking for you.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Hello, Miss Kimura. Melissa was looking for you.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Hello, Miss Kimura. Melissa was looking for you."

translation: Dzień dobry, pani Kimura. Melissa pani szukała.

source_text: I’m running a bit late.

structure.raw_value: AdBaOp.I’m running a bit late.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaOp.I’m running a bit late."

translation: Trochę się spóźniam.

source_text: She left to get some evidence checked out.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.She left to get some evidence checked out.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.She left to get some evidence checked out."

translation: Poszła zbadać pewne dowody.

source_text: Do you know what this is about?

structure.raw_value: AdBaOp.Do you know what this is about?
structure.script_literal: "AdBaOp.Do you know what this is about?"

translation: Wiesz, o co chodzi?

source_text: I figured out some new developments.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.I figured out some new developments.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.I figured out some new developments."

translation: Odkryłem kilka nowych faktów.

source_text: Walk with me, 1Hero. You can give me the rundown.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx.Walk with me, 1Hero. You can give me the rundown.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx.Walk with me, 1Hero. You can give me the rundown."

translation: Chodź ze mną, 1Hero. Po drodze zdasz mi relację.

source_text: Uhh, sure thing.

structure.raw_value: McHaOp.Uhh, sure thing.
structure.script_literal: "McHaOp.Uhh, sure thing."

translation: Yyy, jasne.

source_text: I can see a key way up there. But my shoes are too slippery to climb a marble column.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.I can see a key way up there. But my shoes are too slippery to climb a marble column.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.I can see a key way up there. But my shoes are too slippery to climb a marble column."

translation: Widzę tam wysoko klucz, ale moje buty są zbyt śliskie, żebym wspiął się po marmurowej kolumnie.

source_text: Uhhh… Yeah. I’m here.

structure.raw_value: McFrCl.Uhhh… Yeah. I’m here.
structure.script_literal: "McFrCl.Uhhh… Yeah. I’m here."

translation: Yyy… Tak. Jestem tutaj.

source_text: Get out of here, Canmore. You’re not supposed to be here.

structure.raw_value: ObAnOp.Get out of here, Canmore. You’re not supposed to be here.
structure.script_literal: "ObAnOp.Get out of here, Canmore. You’re not supposed to be here."

translation: Wynoś się stąd, Canmore. Nie powinno cię tu być.

source_text: Canmore? What are you doing here?

structure.raw_value: OaAnOp>.Canmore? What are you doing here?
structure.script_literal: "OaAnOp>.Canmore? What are you doing here?"

translation: Canmore? Co ty tu robisz?

source_text: It’s okay. He’s with me.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx.It’s okay. He’s with me.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx.It’s okay. He’s with me."

translation: W porządku. Jest ze mną.

source_text: How are the interrogations going?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.How are the interrogations going?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.How are the interrogations going?"

translation: Jak idą przesłuchania?

source_text: The woman is mostly clueless, but I’m making slow progress.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx.The woman is mostly clueless, but I’m making slow progress.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx.The woman is mostly clueless, but I’m making slow progress."

translation: Ta kobieta niewiele wie, ale powoli robię postępy.

source_text: What about the dude?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.What about the dude?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.What about the dude?"

translation: A co z tym facetem?

source_text: The uniformed officers have him. They won't release him to me.

structure.raw_value: MeAnEx.The uniformed officers have him. They won't release him to me.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnEx.The uniformed officers have him. They won't release him to me."

translation: Zajmują się nim mundurowi. Nie chcą mi go przekazać.

source_text: You know how they are.

structure.raw_value: MeAnDe.You know how they are.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnDe.You know how they are."

translation: Wiesz, jacy oni są.

source_text: Dammit. We need as much info as possible for Kimberly.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.Dammit. We need as much info as possible for Kimberly.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.Dammit. We need as much info as possible for Kimberly."

translation: Cholera. Musimy zdobyć jak najwięcej informacji dla Kimberly.

source_text: Paul wants to do a live broadcast.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx.Paul wants to do a live broadcast.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx.Paul wants to do a live broadcast."

translation: Paul chce przeprowadzić transmisję na żywo.

source_text: An interview?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.An interview?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.An interview?"

translation: Wywiad?

source_text: With both of us. Are you up for it?

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx.With both of us. Are you up for it?
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx.With both of us. Are you up for it?"

translation: Z nami obojgiem. Dasz radę?

source_text: We better prepare.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.We better prepare.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.We better prepare."

translation: Lepiej się przygotujmy.

source_text: I’m doing my best. But I can only get so much in such a limited time.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx.I’m doing my best. But I can only get so much in such a limited time.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx.I’m doing my best. But I can only get so much in such a limited time."

translation: Staram się, jak mogę. Ale w tak krótkim czasie nie zdołam zdobyć zbyt wielu informacji.

source_text: Too bad I can’t help…

structure.raw_value: McSaDe.Too bad I can’t help…
structure.script_literal: "McSaDe.Too bad I can’t help…"

translation: Szkoda, że nie mogę pomóc…

source_text: You know, I have a disguise… I could try and sneak over there.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.You know, I have a disguise… I could try and sneak over there.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.You know, I have a disguise… I could try and sneak over there."

translation: Wiesz, mam przebranie… Mógłbym spróbować się tam zakraść.

source_text: 1Hero! That’s illegal. You’ll get arrested and then it’ll be you on the other side of the interrogation table.

structure.raw_value: MeAnEx.1Hero! That’s illegal. You’ll get arrested and then it’ll be you on the other side of the interrogation table.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnEx.1Hero! That’s illegal. You’ll get arrested and then it’ll be you on the other side of the interrogation table."

translation: 1Hero! To nielegalne. Aresztują cię i sam zasiądziesz po drugiej stronie stołu przesłuchań.

source_text: Haha. Don’t worry about me.

structure.raw_value: McFlOpNo4.Haha. Don’t worry about me.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOpNo4.Haha. Don’t worry about me."

translation: Haha. Nie martw się o mnie.

source_text: Still cocky.

structure.raw_value: MeAnDe.Still cocky.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnDe.Still cocky."

translation: Nadal taki pewny siebie.

source_text: Should I change?

structure.raw_value: McFlDe.Should I change?
structure.script_literal: "McFlDe.Should I change?"

translation: Powinienem się przebrać?

source_text: Don’t tell Andrea about any of this.
